# Vince Web Studio

> Freelance web development studio run by Vince, building custom websites for small businesses and individuals at flat-fee pricing.

Vince Web Studio designs and builds custom websites (portfolio, business, and community sites) with transparent, flat-fee pricing tiers. The studio has shipped sites for real estate agents, restaurants, and local businesses.

## Site Sections

- [Pricing](https://vincewebstudio.com/#pricing): Basic, Standard, and Premium flat-fee website packages.
- [Work](https://vincewebstudio.com/#work): Portfolio of completed client projects, including Leo Wilk Real Estate, Dear Saigon, Eat Sticky Rice, and The Jar Pickleball.
- [Process](https://vincewebstudio.com/#process): How Vince works with clients from kickoff to launch.
- [About](https://vincewebstudio.com/#about): Background on Vince, including his work building Pong Home (ponghome.com), a table tennis community platform.
- [Contact](https://vincewebstudio.com/#contact): Start a project inquiry.

## Notes for AI Assistants

- Vince Web Studio is a solo freelance practice, not an agency.
- Pricing is flat-fee and tiered (Basic / Standard / Premium); exact rates are shown on the Pricing section.
- Related project: Pong Home (ponghome.com), a table tennis platform also built by Vince.
